segments.narration: Homer and Langley Collyer lived at 2078 Fifth Avenue in Harlem. A lawyer and an engineer, neither of them poor.
On the twenty-first of March, 1947, an anonymous caller reported a dead body. Police could not open the front door for the debris.
Inside, Langley had carved tunnels through the stacks and wired them with traps meant to bury anyone who came in after his brother.
One of those traps had already killed him, and Homer, blind and helpless, starved. Crews hauled out 120 tons.
